description: Validates data against a JSON Schema (draft 2020-12/07 core: types, required, properties, items, enums, ranges, patterns, formats, combinators, local $ref), or checks raw JSON syntax when only json is given. Returns valid true/false and a list of errors with their paths. Use it to check API payloads or model output against a schema. Limits: remote $ref is not fetched; only core vocabulary is supported.

json.description: raw JSON text (syntax check, or data as text)

name: json_validate
title: JSON Schema Validator
